name: Wildcard Seal of Arcane Wrath adds Arcane damage to main hand auto attacks and judges for Arcane damage (#10602)
contract: Seal of Arcane Wrath 277854 reads 'Paladin melee abilities, and main hand auto attacks deal additional Arcane damage. Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal ${$SP*0.5+$AP*0.325} Arcane damage to an enemy. Scales with Seal of Righteousness modifiers.'

It copies Seal of Righteousness 21084 (ProcFlags 0x14, same attributes and family flags) and its damage spell 277856 copies 25742, but it had no spell_proc row or script, so it dealt no damage. The per-hit amount follows the 21084 tooltip: 1 + MWS * (0.0085 * AP + 0.072 * SP).

Judging the seal cast its effect 2 dummy amount 277856 (BasePoints -1) for 0 damage. It must cast Judgement of Arcane Wrath 277857 ('${1+0.325*$AP+0.5*$SPA}', BasePoints 1 DieSides -1, spell_bonus_data 0.5 SP / 0.325 AP). With the 1000 attack power and 1000 Arcane spell power the scenario pins, the tooltip formula is 826 before the caster's percentage done modifiers.

The engine's own done amount for 277857 (Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone on base 1, the spell_damage_done metric) must carry both coefficient terms: at least 700, where losing the AP term would leave at most 501 and losing the SP term at most 326. The landed hit must then equal that done amount up to the 0..2 base roll, or twice it on a critical strike. A partial resist or a damage-taken reduction would push the ratio below 1. CoA monster resistance is removed with a level-30 dummy and Increased Spell Penetration 38 (26175), as in runemaster-air-engraving-native-spell-copy-6003.
With the seal up, three landed main hand swings each add one 277856 hit; with it cancelled, further swings add none.

The engine's done amount for 277857 is 834 at 1000 AP / 1000 Arcane SP, so the tooltip formula is applied; the landed hit is about 8% lower from a target-side damage-taken reduction on the test dummy, outside this fix.
